summary:
#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[Madelaine Davies Kellock] (Research Fellow in Psychiatric Epidemiology, UCL) – October 22, 2024, 8:33 AM:**  
  - Sent a draft EMA survey for App Store approval.  
  - Confirmed the need for GPS location stamps in EMA surveys.  
  - Inquired about the minimum length of time required to measure heart rate variability.  
  - *Key quote:* "Have you heard back from your team regarding the minimum length of time required to measure heart rate variability?"  

- **[Amin Tavassolian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – October 22, 2024, 11:07 AM:**  
  - Acknowledged receipt of the draft EMA survey and confirmed GPS location stamps.  
  - Promised to check with the team about heart rate variability measurement.  
  - Requested a meeting to discuss a custom app form.  
  - *Key quote:* "Could we schedule a quick meeting to go through this together?"  

- **[Madelaine Davies Kellock] (Research Fellow in Psychiatric Epidemiology, UCL) – October 23, 2024, 1:48 AM:**  
  - Requested GPS data collection at intervals of 10-30 seconds.  
  - Inquired about receiving precision variables or location accuracy data.  
  - *Key quote:* "Can I also check that we will receive a precision variable or location accuracy data too?"  

- **[Amin Tavassolian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – October 23, 2024, 12:41 AM:**  
  - Confirmed the feasibility of GPS data collection at requested intervals.  
  - Provided a link for more details on GPS data.  
  - *Key quote:* "This is certainly possible and we can adjust the data collection behavior in any way you want."  

- **[John Pickavance] (Principal Data Scientist, Bradford Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust) – October 28, 2024, 11:45 AM:**  
  - Inquired about bypassing Garmin Connect for syncing smartwatch data.  
  - Referenced a previous quote and cost estimate for custom data journey.  
  - *Key quote:* "Our understanding is that Avicenna was able to use Garmin’s standard SDK to bypass Garmin Connect and directly sync smartwatch data with the research database."  

- **[Amin Tavassolian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – October 30, 2024, 2:39 AM:**  
  - Acknowledged the resolution of the Garmin SDK confusion.  
  - Mentioned upcoming communication regarding the custom app and IRB document.  
  - *Key quote:* "I believe Amin G. will get back to you about the custom app, the IRB document, and other items by tomorrow."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – October 31, 2024, 7:28 PM:**  
  - Shared a Google Drive folder with necessary files for the project.  
  - *Key quote:* "I have created a folder on Google drive including all the files necessary as per our last meeting."  

- **[Madelaine Davies Kellock] (Research Fellow in Psychiatric Epidemiology, UCL) – November 22, 2024, 8:12 AM:**  
  - Followed up on a supplier registration form for UCL.  
  - Requested completion of the form to avoid delays.  
  - *Key quote:* "Would you be able to chase this up for me?"  

- **[Amin Tavassolian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – November 22, 2024, 8:12 AM:**  
  - Promised to follow up with the finance team regarding the supplier form.  
  - *Key quote:* "I'll check this with the finance team and make sure you'll have the completed form before Monday."  

- **[John Pickavance] (Principal Data Scientist, Bradford Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust) – December 13, 2024, 3:57 AM:**  
  - Reported issues accessing the shared folder for uploading graphics.  
  - *Key quote:* "Following our meeting last week, I still don’t have access to the shared folder to upload the graphics."  

- **[Amin Tavassolian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – December 13, 2024, 3:00 PM:**  
  - Provided an alternative link for the shared folder.  
  - *Key quote:* "Could you please try the following link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11c_KbVBGnusItfwVxFqV2nqEQlhVLUaa?usp=sharing"  

- **[John Pickavance] (Principal Data Scientist, Bradford Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust) – December 13, 2024, 7:00 PM:**  
  - Attached placeholder graphics for the app.  
  - *Key quote:* "Please find the graphics attached. They still haven’t gone through co-production so are subject to change but can be used as placeholders for the time being."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – December 25, 2024, 2:02 PM:**  
  - Discussed the need for SensorKit integration for social media app usage.  
  - Recommended releasing the custom app first without SensorKit.  
  - Requested finalized items for the custom app sheet.  
  - *Key quote:* "We highly recommend you begin the entitlement application process as soon as possible to make sure we can publish the application in time."  

- **[Madelaine Davies Kellock] (Research Fellow in Psychiatric Epidemiology, UCL) – January 6, 2025, 1:53 PM:**  
  - Confirmed that a preliminary ethics submission letter would suffice for app release.  
  - *Key quote:* "Can I check with you - Amin T had previously said that an official letter stating that ethics had been submitted was sufficient for releasing the app."  

- **[John Pickavance] (Principal Data Scientist, Bradford Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust) – January 6, 2025, 8:03 PM:**  
  - Clarified the app's design philosophy for hosting multiple studies.  
  - Requested a placeholder logo for the VIBE study.  
  - *Key quote:* "Our design philosophy for the app is that we would brand it BiB NextGen and then have the studies (e.g., VIBE) embedded within it."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – January 7, 2025, 12:38 PM:**  
  - Confirmed moving forward with a single-study app to accelerate approval.  
  - *Key quote:* "We'll move forward with single study then :)"  

#### **2. Timeline**  
- **[October 22, 2024]:** Draft EMA survey shared for App Store approval.  
- **[October 23, 2024]:** GPS data collection requirements discussed.  
- **[October 28, 2024]:** Inquiry about bypassing Garmin Connect for data syncing.  
- **[December 13, 2024]:** Issues with shared folder access and placeholder graphics provided.  
- **[December 25, 2024]:** Discussion on SensorKit integration and app release requirements.  
- **[January 6, 2025]:** Confirmation on ethics submission and app design philosophy.  

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**  
- **EMA Survey Approval:** Draft survey shared for App Store approval, with GPS location stamps confirmed.  
- **Garmin SDK Confusion:** Clarification provided on Avicenna's access to Garmin’s standard SDK.  
- **Supplier Registration:** Follow-up on UCL supplier form to avoid payment delays.  
- **SensorKit Integration:** Discussion on releasing the app first without SensorKit and applying for entitlement later.  

#### **4. Action Items**  
- **Pending:**  
  - Finalize and submit the supplier registration form (assigned to Avicenna finance team).  
  - Provide finalized items for the custom app sheet (assigned to UCL team).  
- **Completed:**  
  - Draft EMA survey shared for App Store approval.  
  - Clarification on Garmin SDK access.  

#### **5. Technical Details**  
- **GPS Data Collection:** Confirmed at intervals of 10-30 seconds with precision variables.  
- **SensorKit Integration:** Required for social media app usage; recommended to release app first without it.  

#### **6. Next Steps**  
- **Action 1:** Complete and submit the supplier registration form (responsible: Avicenna finance team).  
- **Action 2:** Finalize custom app sheet items (responsible: UCL team).  
- **Action 3:** Begin entitlement application process for SensorKit (responsible: UCL team).
